App versions 1.0.14 and later. Read the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use in legal set 2. Check their stated version scope and publication status; these links do not announce an app release.

These versions require a saved Accept for both documents before play and before ordinary usage statistics through Firebase Analytics and GameAnalytics or Firebase Crashlytics reporting start. Existing younger-player restrictions still apply. There are no separate in-game off switches for this ordinary collection after Accept.

Advertising choices are separate. Google UMP manages advertising permission; Accept does not grant advertising purposes. Use Manage and the SDK’s Confirm choices action to save partial choices or choices granting no advertising purposes. Those choices do not revoke a saved entry confirmation.

App versions 1.0.13 and earlier. The policy text below is retained for those earlier versions and describes their optional usage-statistics and crash-diagnostics controls. It does not describe the 1.0.14+ entry requirement.
